Karthik — this looks useful, thanks. A few follow-ups from InfoSec/Legal before we commit engineers:

1) Retention tiers: we need explicit values for (a) application logs (search/diagnostic) — suggest 30 days and optionally 365 days for archived logs; (b) model inputs/embeddings — we'd like a short/medium/long tier (30 / 365 / 7 years) depending on use case. Are these supported or configurable?

Finally — we'll return the ledgerworks-qna.xlsx with their internal risk ratings; please upload the partial SIG you mentioned as an XLS so our team can mark org-specific items.

Alex — appreciate the specifics. Quick commitments from our side:

- Retention tiers: Redwood supports configurable retention windows per tenant. We can support application logs 30 days by default with a 365-day archive option; embeddings can be configured to 30 / 365 / 2555 days (7 years) per contract. We'll include configuration knobs in the MAP tracker.
- EU residency: we can provision an EU-only tenant (data at rest + backups in EU region) and integrate with a customer-managed EU KMS. Naomi will note the region/keystore approach in the control mapping.
- Token logging & PII: by default our hosted API retains prompts for 30 days to support debugging and rate-limiting; there is a pseudonymization toggle and a no-retention contractual option for enterprise plans — Naomi will flag control coverage.
- SOC2 mapping: Naomi will upload the PDF and a 1–2 page control map calling out encryption, KMS, and retention controls by 2026-05-04.
- SIG file: Ben will upload a partially completed sig-template.xlsx to the Drive by 2026-05-01; we'll ask LedgerWorks to complete org rows and return by 2026-05-06.
- DPA: Vanessa will aim to provide a redline to your team by 2026-05-09. We will also circulate a DocuSign envelope for signature by 2026-05-12 if everything aligns. Link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ldg-dpa-2026

I'll update the MAP tracker with these commitments. If Legal/InfoSec at LedgerWorks wants a short 30-minute walkthrough on the SOC2 mapping, Naomi and Vanessa are available next week (suggest 2026-05-05 or 2026-05-06).

I'll mark this as priority and follow up as artifacts are uploaded.
